description: Geschäftsführer-Cockpit für microtech büro+ auf Basis der Export-Layouts (Artikel, Adressen, Vorgänge mit Positionen, Übersicht und Archiv).
author: Datenmonster
hinweise: Erwartet im SQL-Server die Tabellen dbo.Artikel, dbo.Adressen, dbo.Vorgang, dbo.VorgangArchiv, dbo.VorgangPosition, dbo.VorgangPositionArchiv und die Views dbo.vVorgang, dbo.vVorgangPosition (Spaltennamen = büro+-Feldnamen ohne Punkte).
Umsatz = gebuchte Rechnungen und Sammelrechnungen; Rechnungskorrekturen werden gesondert ausgewiesen und abgezogen.

config_required.label: Lieferschein ohne Rechnung melden ab … Tagen
Angebot gilt als alt ab … Tagen
Einkaufspreis unplausibel ab dem …-fachen des Umsatzes

sql_nodes.sql:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
), p AS (
    SELECT b.*,
        CASE WHEN VogDat >= :von AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, :bis) THEN 1
             WHEN VogDat >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :von) AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis)) THEN 2 END AS Per
    FROM b
), s AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 AND Vz = 1 THEN Netto ELSE 0 END) AS Umsatz,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 AND Vz = 1 THEN Netto ELSE 0 END) AS UmsatzVJ,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 AND Vz = -1 THEN Netto ELSE 0 END) AS KorrekturWert,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 AND Vz = -1 THEN Netto ELSE 0 END) AS KorrekturWertVJ,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 AND Vz = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KorrekturAnzahl,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Vz * Ek ELSE 0 END) AS Wareneinsatz,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN Vz * Ek ELSE 0 END) AS WareneinsatzVJ,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Vz * (Netto - Ek) ELSE 0 END) AS Rohertrag,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN Vz * (Netto - Ek) ELSE 0 END) AS RohertragVJ,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 AND Vz = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Rechnungen,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 AND Vz = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RechnungenVJ,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Per = 1 AND Vz = 1 THEN VogAdrNr END) AS AktiveKunden,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Per = 2 AND Vz = 1 THEN VogAdrNr END) AS AktiveKundenVJ
    FROM p WHERE Per IS NOT NULL
), ohne_ek AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS PosOhneEk, ISNULL(SUM(pos.NettoPos), 0) AS UmsatzOhneEk
    FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition pos
    JOIN b ON b.VogID = pos.VogID AND b.Vz = 1
    WHERE b.VogDat >= :von AND b.VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, :bis)
      AND pos.ArtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(pos.EEkRoh, 0) = 0 AND pos.NettoPos > 0
)
SELECT
    CAST(Umsatz AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz, CAST(UmsatzVJ AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UmsatzVJ,
    CAST(KorrekturWert AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS KorrekturWert, CAST(KorrekturWertVJ AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS KorrekturWertVJ,
    KorrekturAnzahl,
    CAST(Umsatz - KorrekturWert AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UmsatzNachKorrektur,
    CAST(UmsatzVJ - KorrekturWertVJ AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UmsatzNachKorrekturVJ,
    CAST(Umsatz - KorrekturWert AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Warenumsatz,
    CAST(Wareneinsatz AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Wareneinsatz, CAST(WareneinsatzVJ AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS WareneinsatzVJ,
    CAST(Rohertrag AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Rohertrag, CAST(RohertragVJ AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS RohertragVJ,
    CAST(CASE WHEN Umsatz - KorrekturWert > 0 THEN 100.0 * Rohertrag / (Umsatz - KorrekturWert) END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Marge,
    CAST(CASE WHEN UmsatzVJ - KorrekturWertVJ > 0 THEN 100.0 * RohertragVJ / (UmsatzVJ - KorrekturWertVJ) END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS MargeVJ,
    Rechnungen, RechnungenVJ,
    CAST(CASE WHEN Rechnungen > 0 THEN Umsatz / Rechnungen END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AvgRechnung,
    CAST(CASE WHEN RechnungenVJ > 0 THEN UmsatzVJ / RechnungenVJ END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AvgRechnungVJ,
    AktiveKunden, AktiveKundenVJ,
    PosOhneEk, CAST(UmsatzOhneEk AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UmsatzOhneEk
FROM s CROSS JOIN ohne_ek

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Angebot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AngeboteOffen,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Angebot' THEN VogGPreisNt ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AngeboteWert,
    SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Angebot' AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, -90, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AngeboteAlt,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Angebot' AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, -90, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) THEN VogGPreisNt ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AngeboteAltWert,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Angebot' AND VogDat >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) THEN VogGPreisNt ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AngeboteFrischWert,
    SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Auftragsbestätigung' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AuftraegeOffen,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Auftragsbestätigung' THEN VogGPreisNt ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AuftragsbestandWert,
    SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Lieferschein' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LieferscheineOffen,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Lieferschein' THEN VogGPreisNt ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS LieferscheineWert,
    MAX(CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Lieferschein' THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, VogDat, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) END) AS LieferscheinAeltesterTage
FROM dbo.Vorgang
WHERE ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0

WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
), cur AS (
    SELECT CONVERT(char(7), VogDat, 120) AS Monat, SUM(Vz * Netto) AS Umsatz, SUM(Vz * (Netto - Ek)) AS Rohertrag
    FROM b WHERE VogDat >= :von AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, :bis)
    GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), VogDat, 120)
), vj AS (
    SELECT CONVERT(char(7), DATEADD(YEAR, 1, VogDat), 120) AS Monat, SUM(Vz * Netto) AS UmsatzVorjahr
    FROM b WHERE VogDat >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :von) AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis))
    GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), DATEADD(YEAR, 1, VogDat), 120)
)
SELECT ISNULL(cur.Monat, vj.Monat) AS Monat,
    CAST(ISNULL(cur.Umsatz, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz,
    CAST(ISNULL(vj.UmsatzVorjahr, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UmsatzVorjahr,
    CAST(ISNULL(cur.Rohertrag, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Rohertrag
FROM cur FULL OUTER JOIN vj ON cur.Monat = vj.Monat
ORDER BY Monat

WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
), m AS (
    SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.Netto DESC) AS rn
    FROM b WHERE CONVERT(char(7), b.VogDat, 120) = :monat
)
SELECT 0 AS Sortierung, m.VogBelegNr AS Beleg, m.VogArt AS Art, CONVERT(char(10), m.VogDat, 104) AS Datum,
    m.VogAdrNr AS AdrNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.AdrReNa2, ''))), ''), CONCAT('Adresse ', m.VogAdrNr)) AS Kunde,
    CAST(m.Vz * m.Netto AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz,
    CAST(m.Vz * (m.Netto - m.Ek) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Rohertrag,
    m.VogVerk AS Bearbeiter, CAST(m.VogID AS varchar(20)) AS VogID
FROM m LEFT JOIN dbo.Adressen a ON a.AdrAdrNr = m.VogAdrNr
WHERE m.rn <= 499
UNION ALL
SELECT 1, '', '', '', NULL, CONCAT('… ', COUNT(*), ' weitere Belege'),
    CAST(SUM(Vz * Netto) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(SUM(Vz * (Netto - Ek)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), '', ''
FROM m WHERE rn > 499
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY Sortierung, Umsatz DESC

SELECT TOP 500 p.Pos, p.ArtNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(art.ArtKuBez1, ''), LEFT(art.ArtBez1, 80)) AS Bezeichnung,
    CAST(p.BuchMge AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Menge, p.Einh AS Einheit,
    CAST(p.EPrNt AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS Preis, CAST(p.EPreisFak AS DECIMAL(9,4)) AS Preisfaktor,
    p.NettoPos AS Umsatz, p.EkPos AS Einsatz, p.RohertragPos AS Rohertrag
FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p
LEFT JOIN dbo.Artikel art ON art.ArtArtNr = p.ArtNr
WHERE p.VogID = CAST(:vogid AS int)
ORDER BY p.ZeilenNr

SELECT TOP 500 b.VogBelegNr AS Beleg, CONVERT(char(10), b.VogDat, 104) AS Datum,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, b.VogDat, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AS TageOffen,
    b.VogAdrNr AS AdrNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.AdrReNa2, ''))), ''), CONCAT('Adresse ', b.VogAdrNr)) AS Kunde,
    CAST(b.VogGPreisNt AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Wert, b.VogVerk AS Bearbeiter, CAST(b.VogID AS varchar(20)) AS VogID
FROM dbo.Vorgang b LEFT JOIN dbo.Adressen a ON a.AdrAdrNr = b.VogAdrNr
WHERE b.VogArt = 'Lieferschein' AND ISNULL(b.VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
  AND b.VogDat <= DATEADD(DAY, -{{lieferschein_tage}}, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
ORDER BY b.VogDat

SELECT b.VogBelegNr AS Beleg, CONVERT(char(10), b.VogDat, 104) AS Datum,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, b.VogDat, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AS Alter_Tage,
    b.VogAdrNr AS AdrNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.AdrReNa2, ''))), ''), CONCAT('Adresse ', b.VogAdrNr)) AS Kunde,
    CAST(b.VogGPreisNt AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Wert, b.VogVerk AS Bearbeiter, CAST(b.VogID AS varchar(20)) AS VogID
FROM dbo.Vorgang b LEFT JOIN dbo.Adressen a ON a.AdrAdrNr = b.VogAdrNr
WHERE b.VogArt = 'Angebot' AND ISNULL(b.VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
  AND b.VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, -{{angebot_tage}}, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
ORDER BY b.VogGPreisNt DESC

WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
)
SELECT TOP 500 p.ArtNr, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(art.ArtKuBez1, ''), LEFT(art.ArtBez1, 80))) AS Bezeichnung,
    COUNT(*) AS Positionen, CAST(SUM(p.NettoPos) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz,
    CONVERT(char(10), MAX(b.VogDat), 104) AS LetzterVerkauf
FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p
JOIN b ON b.VogID = p.VogID AND b.Vz = 1
LEFT JOIN dbo.Artikel art ON art.ArtArtNr = p.ArtNr
WHERE b.VogDat >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
  AND p.ArtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(p.EEkRoh, 0) = 0 AND p.NettoPos > 0
GROUP BY p.ArtNr
ORDER BY SUM(p.NettoPos) DESC

mappings.name: büro+ GF – Gesperrte Kunden mit Umsatz

sql_nodes.sql:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
)
SELECT TOP 500 b.VogAdrNr AS AdrNr, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.AdrReNa2, ''))), ''), CONCAT('Adresse ', b.VogAdrNr))) AS Kunde,
    CONVERT(char(10), MAX(a.AdrGspDat), 104) AS GesperrtSeit,
    COUNT(*) AS Rechnungen, CAST(SUM(b.Vz * b.Netto) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz,
    CONVERT(char(10), MAX(b.VogDat), 104) AS LetzteRechnung,
    MAX(LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(a.AdrGspInfo, CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), 200)) AS Sperrgrund
FROM b JOIN dbo.Adressen a ON a.AdrAdrNr = b.VogAdrNr
WHERE a.AdrGspKz = 1 AND b.VogDat >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
GROUP BY b.VogAdrNr
ORDER BY SUM(b.Vz * b.Netto) DESC

mappings.name: büro+ GF – Belege mit unplausiblem Einkaufspreis

sql_nodes.sql:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
)
SELECT TOP 500 b.VogBelegNr AS Beleg, b.VogArt AS Art, CONVERT(char(10), b.VogDat, 104) AS Datum,
    b.VogAdrNr AS AdrNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.AdrReNa2, ''))), ''), CONCAT('Adresse ', b.VogAdrNr)) AS Kunde,
    CAST(b.Netto AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz, CAST(b.Ek AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Einsatz,
    CAST(b.Ek - b.Netto AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Verzerrung,
    CAST(CASE WHEN b.Netto > 0 THEN b.Ek / b.Netto END AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS EkFaktor,
    b.VogVerk AS Bearbeiter, CAST(b.VogID AS varchar(20)) AS VogID
FROM b LEFT JOIN dbo.Adressen a ON a.AdrAdrNr = b.VogAdrNr
WHERE b.Ek > 100 AND b.Ek > b.Netto * {{ek_faktor}}
ORDER BY b.Ek - b.Netto DESC

targets.name: büro+ GF – Belege mit unplausiblem Einkaufspreis

sql_nodes.sql:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
      AND VogDat >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :von) AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, :bis)
), pos AS (
    SELECT p.ArtNr, b.VogID, b.VogAdrNr, b.VogDat,
        b.Vz * p.NettoPos AS Umsatz, b.Vz * p.EkPos AS Einsatz,
        b.Vz * p.BuchMge AS Menge, b.Vz * p.BuchMge * p.EPreisFak AS PE,
        b.Vz * p.BuchMge * p.EPreisFak * art.{{listenpreis}} AS Listenwert,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(art.ArtWgrNrInfo)), ''), 'ohne Warengruppe') AS Warengruppe,
        CASE WHEN b.VogDat >= :von THEN 1
             WHEN b.VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis)) THEN 2 END AS Per
    FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p
    JOIN b ON b.VogID = p.VogID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Artikel art ON art.ArtArtNr = p.ArtNr
    WHERE p.ArtKz = 1 AND p.ArtNr IS NOT NULL
),
s AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN ArtNr END) AS ArtikelVerkauft,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN ArtNr END) AS ArtikelVerkauftVJ,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Warengruppe END) AS Warengruppen,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Umsatz ELSE 0 END) AS Umsatz,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 AND Listenwert > 0 THEN Umsatz ELSE 0 END) AS UmsatzMitListe,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 AND Listenwert > 0 THEN Listenwert ELSE 0 END) AS Listenwert,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 AND Listenwert > 0 THEN Umsatz ELSE 0 END) AS UmsatzMitListeVJ,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 AND Listenwert > 0 THEN Listenwert ELSE 0 END) AS ListenwertVJ
    FROM pos WHERE Per IS NOT NULL
), unter_ek AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Einsatz - Umsatz ELSE 0 END) AS VerlustUnterEk,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN Einsatz - Umsatz ELSE 0 END) AS VerlustUnterEkVJ,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PosUnterEk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN ArtNr END) AS ArtikelUnterEk
    FROM pos WHERE Per IS NOT NULL AND Umsatz > 0 AND Einsatz > Umsatz
), top20 AS (
    SELECT SUM(u) AS UmsatzTop20 FROM (
        SELECT TOP 20 SUM(Umsatz) AS u FROM pos WHERE Per = 1 GROUP BY ArtNr ORDER BY SUM(Umsatz) DESC) t
), letzter AS (
    SELECT p.ArtNr, MAX(k.VogDat) AS Letzter
    FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p JOIN dbo.vVorgang k ON k.VogID = p.VogID
    WHERE k.VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung') AND p.ArtKz = 1
    GROUP BY p.ArtNr
), sortiment AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN art.ArtGspKz = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AktiveArtikel,
        SUM(CASE WHEN art.ArtGspKz = 0 AND (l.Letzter IS NULL OR l.Letzter <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OhneVerkauf12M,
        SUM(CASE WHEN art.ArtGspKz = 1 AND l.Letzter > DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS GesperrtVerkauft
    FROM dbo.Artikel art LEFT JOIN letzter l ON l.ArtNr = art.ArtArtNr
)
SELECT s.ArtikelVerkauft, s.ArtikelVerkauftVJ, s.Warengruppen,
    CAST(CASE WHEN s.Umsatz > 0 THEN 100.0 * t.UmsatzTop20 / s.Umsatz END AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS AnteilTop20,
    CAST(t.UmsatzTop20 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UmsatzTop20,
    CAST(CASE WHEN s.Listenwert > 0 THEN 100.0 * (1 - s.UmsatzMitListe / s.Listenwert) END AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS Nachlass,
    CAST(CASE WHEN s.ListenwertVJ > 0 THEN 100.0 * (1 - s.UmsatzMitListeVJ / s.ListenwertVJ) END AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS NachlassVJ,
    CAST(s.Listenwert - s.UmsatzMitListe AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NachlassWert,
    CAST(ISNULL(u.VerlustUnterEk, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS VerlustUnterEk,
    CAST(ISNULL(u.VerlustUnterEkVJ, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS VerlustUnterEkVJ,
    ISNULL(u.PosUnterEk, 0) AS PosUnterEk, ISNULL(u.ArtikelUnterEk, 0) AS ArtikelUnterEk,
    so.AktiveArtikel, so.OhneVerkauf12M, so.GesperrtVerkauft,
    CAST(CASE WHEN so.AktiveArtikel > 0 THEN 100.0 * so.OhneVerkauf12M / so.AktiveArtikel END AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS AnteilOhneVerkauf
FROM s CROSS JOIN top20 t CROSS JOIN unter_ek u CROSS JOIN sortiment so

WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
      AND VogDat >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :von) AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, :bis)
), pos AS (
    SELECT p.ArtNr, b.VogID, b.VogAdrNr, b.VogDat,
        b.Vz * p.NettoPos AS Umsatz, b.Vz * p.EkPos AS Einsatz,
        b.Vz * p.BuchMge AS Menge, b.Vz * p.BuchMge * p.EPreisFak AS PE,
        b.Vz * p.BuchMge * p.EPreisFak * art.{{listenpreis}} AS Listenwert,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(art.ArtWgrNrInfo)), ''), 'ohne Warengruppe') AS Warengruppe,
        CASE WHEN b.VogDat >= :von THEN 1
             WHEN b.VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis)) THEN 2 END AS Per
    FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p
    JOIN b ON b.VogID = p.VogID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Artikel art ON art.ArtArtNr = p.ArtNr
    WHERE p.ArtKz = 1 AND p.ArtNr IS NOT NULL
),
g AS (SELECT Warengruppe, SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Umsatz ELSE 0 END) AS U1, SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN Umsatz ELSE 0 END) AS U2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Umsatz - Einsatz ELSE 0 END) AS R1, SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN Umsatz - Einsatz ELSE 0 END) AS R2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN ArtNr END) AS A1, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN VogAdrNr END) AS K1 FROM pos WHERE Per IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Warengruppe)
SELECT Warengruppe,

WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
)
SELECT TOP 500 b.VogBelegNr AS Beleg, b.VogArt AS Art, CONVERT(char(10), b.VogDat, 104) AS Datum,
    b.VogAdrNr AS AdrNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.AdrReNa2, ''))), ''), CONCAT('Adresse ', b.VogAdrNr)) AS Kunde,
    CAST(SUM(b.Vz * p.BuchMge) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Menge,
    CAST(MAX(p.EPrNt) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS Preis, CAST(MAX(p.EEkRoh) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS EkPreis,
    CAST(SUM(b.Vz * p.NettoPos) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz,
    CAST(SUM(b.Vz * p.RohertragPos) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Rohertrag,
    b.VogVerk AS Bearbeiter, CAST(b.VogID AS varchar(20)) AS VogID
FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p
JOIN b ON b.VogID = p.VogID
LEFT JOIN dbo.Adressen a ON a.AdrAdrNr = b.VogAdrNr
WHERE p.ArtNr = :artnr AND b.VogDat >= :von AND b.VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, :bis)
GROUP BY b.VogID, b.VogBelegNr, b.VogArt, b.VogDat, b.VogAdrNr, a.AdrReNa2, b.VogVerk
ORDER BY b.VogDat DESC

sql_nodes.sql:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
      AND VogDat >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :von) AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, :bis)
), pos AS (
    SELECT p.ArtNr, b.VogID, b.VogAdrNr, b.VogDat,
        b.Vz * p.NettoPos AS Umsatz, b.Vz * p.EkPos AS Einsatz,
        b.Vz * p.BuchMge AS Menge, b.Vz * p.BuchMge * p.EPreisFak AS PE,
        b.Vz * p.BuchMge * p.EPreisFak * art.{{listenpreis}} AS Listenwert,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(art.ArtWgrNrInfo)), ''), 'ohne Warengruppe') AS Warengruppe,
        CASE WHEN b.VogDat >= :von THEN 1
             WHEN b.VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis)) THEN 2 END AS Per
    FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p
    JOIN b ON b.VogID = p.VogID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Artikel art ON art.ArtArtNr = p.ArtNr
    WHERE p.ArtKz = 1 AND p.ArtNr IS NOT NULL
),
a AS (
    SELECT ArtNr, COUNT(*) AS Positionen, SUM(Menge) AS M1, SUM(PE) AS PE1,
        SUM(Umsatz) AS U1, SUM(Einsatz) AS E1, MAX(VogDat) AS Letzter
    FROM pos WHERE Per = 1 AND Umsatz > 0 AND Einsatz > Umsatz
    GROUP BY ArtNr
)
SELECT TOP 200 a.ArtNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(art.ArtKuBez1, ''), LEFT(art.ArtBez1, 80)) AS Bezeichnung, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(art.ArtWgrNrInfo)), ''), 'ohne Warengruppe') AS Warengruppe, a.Positionen,
    CAST(a.U1 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz, CAST(a.E1 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Einsatz,
    CAST(a.U1 - a.E1 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Rohertrag,
    CAST(CASE WHEN a.PE1 <> 0 THEN a.U1 / a.PE1 END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS VkSchnitt,
    CAST(CASE WHEN a.PE1 <> 0 THEN a.E1 / a.PE1 END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS EkSchnitt,
    CAST(art.ArtEkKalk AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS EkKalkHeute,
    CONVERT(char(10), a.Letzter, 104) AS LetzterVerkauf
FROM a LEFT JOIN dbo.Artikel art ON art.ArtArtNr = a.ArtNr
ORDER BY a.U1 - a.E1

WITH b AS (
    SELECT VogID, VogBelegNr, VogArt, VogDat, VogAdrNr, VogVerk, VogVtrNr,
           VogGPreisNt AS Netto, VogGEkRoh AS Ek,
           CASE WHEN VogArt = 'Rechnungskorrektur' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Vz
    FROM dbo.vVorgang
    WHERE VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung', 'Rechnungskorrektur')
      AND VogGebuchtKz = 1 AND ISNULL(VogStorniertKz, 0) = 0
      AND VogArt <> 'Rechnungskorrektur'
      AND ((VogDat > DATEADD(DAY, -90, :bis) AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, :bis))
        OR (VogDat > DATEADD(DAY, -90, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis)) AND VogDat < DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis))))
), pos AS (
    SELECT p.ArtNr, p.NettoPos AS Umsatz, p.EkPos AS Einsatz, p.BuchMge * p.EPreisFak AS PE,
        CASE WHEN b.VogDat > DATEADD(DAY, -90, :bis) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS Per
    FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p JOIN b ON b.VogID = p.VogID
    WHERE p.ArtKz = 1 AND p.ArtNr IS NOT NULL AND p.NettoPos > 0 AND p.EkPos > 0
), a AS (
    SELECT ArtNr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Umsatz END) AS U1, SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN Einsatz END) AS E1, SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 1 THEN PE END) AS P1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN Umsatz END) AS U2, SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN Einsatz END) AS E2, SUM(CASE WHEN Per = 2 THEN PE END) AS P2
    FROM pos GROUP BY ArtNr
), k AS (
    SELECT ArtNr, U1, E1 / P1 AS EkNeu, E2 / P2 AS EkAlt, U1 / P1 AS VkNeu, U2 / P2 AS VkAlt,
        100.0 * (U1 - E1) / U1 AS MargeNeu, 100.0 * (U2 - E2) / U2 AS MargeAlt
    FROM a WHERE P1 > 0 AND P2 > 0 AND U1 > 0 AND U2 > 0
)
SELECT TOP 200 k.ArtNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(art.ArtKuBez1, ''), LEFT(art.ArtBez1, 80)) AS Bezeichnung, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(art.ArtWgrNrInfo)), ''), 'ohne Warengruppe') AS Warengruppe,
    CAST(k.EkAlt AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS EkVorjahr, CAST(k.EkNeu AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS EkJetzt,
    CAST(100.0 * (k.EkNeu - k.EkAlt) / k.EkAlt AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS EkAnstieg,
    CAST(k.VkAlt AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS VkVorjahr, CAST(k.VkNeu AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS VkJetzt,
    CAST(100.0 * (k.VkNeu - k.VkAlt) / k.VkAlt AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS VkAnstieg,
    CAST(k.MargeAlt AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS MargeVorjahr, CAST(k.MargeNeu AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS MargeJetzt,
    CAST(art.{{listenpreis}} AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Listenpreis, CONVERT(char(10), art.ArtVkDat, 104) AS PreisGeaendert,
    CAST(k.U1 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Umsatz90Tage,
    CAST(k.U1 * (k.EkNeu - k.EkAlt) / NULLIF(k.EkNeu, 0) - k.U1 * (k.VkNeu - k.VkAlt) / NULLIF(k.VkNeu, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS MargeVerlust90Tage
FROM k LEFT JOIN dbo.Artikel art ON art.ArtArtNr = k.ArtNr
WHERE k.EkNeu > k.EkAlt * 1.03
  AND k.VkNeu < k.VkAlt * (k.EkNeu / k.EkAlt) - 0.005
  AND (art.ArtVkDat IS NULL OR art.ArtVkDat <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis))
ORDER BY k.U1 * (k.EkNeu - k.EkAlt) / NULLIF(k.EkNeu, 0) - k.U1 * (k.VkNeu - k.VkAlt) / NULLIF(k.VkNeu, 0) DESC

WITH letzter AS (
    SELECT p.ArtNr, MAX(k.VogDat) AS Letzter,
        SUM(CASE WHEN k.VogDat > DATEADD(YEAR, -2, :bis) THEN p.NettoPos ELSE 0 END) AS UmsatzVor12M
    FROM dbo.vVorgangPosition p JOIN dbo.vVorgang k ON k.VogID = p.VogID
    WHERE k.VogArt IN ('Rechnung I', 'Sammel Rechnung') AND p.ArtKz = 1
    GROUP BY p.ArtNr
)
SELECT TOP 500 art.ArtArtNr AS ArtNr, COALESCE(NULLIF(art.ArtKuBez1, ''), LEFT(art.ArtBez1, 80)) AS Bezeichnung, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(art.ArtWgrNrInfo)), ''), 'ohne Warengruppe') AS Warengruppe,
    CONVERT(char(10), l.Letzter, 104) AS LetzterVerkauf,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.UmsatzVor12M, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UmsatzVorjahr,
    CAST(art.{{listenpreis}} AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Listenpreis, CONVERT(char(10), art.ArtVkDat, 104) AS PreisGeaendert
FROM dbo.Artikel art LEFT JOIN letzter l ON l.ArtNr = art.ArtArtNr
WHERE art.ArtGspKz = 0 AND (l.Letzter IS NULL OR l.Letzter <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, :bis))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.Letzter IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, l.Letzter DESC

Alle Angebote, die noch in der Vorgangsübersicht stehen – Stand heute, unabhängig vom gewählten Zeitraum.
Der realistische Teil der Pipeline: offene Angebote, die höchstens 90 Tage alt sind.
Auftragsbestätigungen in der Vorgangsübersicht: zugesagt, aber noch nicht geliefert bzw. berechnet.

doku.intro: Die Gesamtsicht für die Geschäftsführung auf Basis von microtech büro+: Umsatz und Rohertrag mit Vorjahresvergleich, die Vertriebspipeline von Angebot bis Lieferschein und was heute zu tun ist. Jede Kurve lässt sich bis auf den einzelnen Beleg und seine Positionen aufklappen.
hinweise: Umsatz zählt gebuchte Rechnungen, nicht Auftragseingänge.
Rechnungskorrekturen führt büro+ mit positivem Betrag; das Cockpit weist sie gesondert aus und zieht sie ab.
Die Pipeline-Kacheln zeigen den Stand heute aus der Vorgangsübersicht, unabhängig vom Zeitraum.
Warengruppen gelten in der heutigen Zuordnung des Artikels – büro+ speichert sie nicht im Beleg.
